content.comment_body: Is there a straightforward way to show in the text display whether a flag or similar is active? For instance, the user needs to choose between "data from input AI1" or "data from input AI2." Currently, I use counters and flags toggling from 0 to 1, with the counter value displayed next to each method: INPUT METHOD F2=AI1: 0 F3=AI2: 1 F4:Exit. Users can press F2 or F3 to switch their selection. Is there a more efficient approach?

It's a bit unclear what you mean exactly. Please check the attachment—does this achieve what you're looking for? This method only works with the "New text setting" feature and applies to digital outputs, but you can also utilize outputs that aren't part of your [product_name].
Yes, that's similar, but I require it for an internal flag.

As mentioned, this method works solely with outputs (and inputs). You can assign an output to an internal flag, allowing the program to function as suggested. If you have a standard [product_name] without extensions, you can utilize outputs beyond Q4, as illustrated in the example with Q15 and Q16, which won't consume actual outputs.
Hello, With a few modifications, you can adapt the sample provided by [user_name]. By using an analog multiplexer, you can select between your analog inputs. Regards,

Hi, To show digital signals: connect the digital signal to a Math function block, with V1 set to 1000. You can use a bargraph from the Math block as an indicator—two fields suffice. Alternatively, you could display status using a text message. Note: the initial firmware release of the [product_name] [article_no] only supports I/O display. Output from a function block is only available with the latest version of [product_name] [article_no]. The attached picture demonstrates the appearance. Hope this helps.
Thank you all for the ideas. I'm confident I can resolve my design challenge now. Additionally, in [product_name] [version_no], flags and other features are included!

analysis.insight_summary: Forum participants are looking for more user-friendly and direct ways to display the status of internal flags or variables on the device's text display. Current solutions rely on indirect methods, such as tying outputs to flags or utilizing math function blocks, which can be cumbersome or depend on the device's hardware version. There is clear feedback requesting native support for displaying internal flags or variables on the user interface.
analysis.user_expectations: Users desire a straightforward solution to display whether an internal flag or variable is active on the text display, mirroring how standard inputs or outputs are indicated—ideally without needing indirect workarounds.
